hooks.name: Kironomics Tool Counter
hooks.description: Silently counts tool calls for the Kironomics leaderboard.

action.command: powershell -NonInteractive -Command "if (-not (Test-Path C:\tmp)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path C:\tmp | Out-Null }; $f = 'C:\tmp\kironomics_tools'; $c = if (Test-Path $f) { [int](Get-Content $f) } else { 0 }; Set-Content $f ($c + 1); echo ok"

hooks.name: Kironomics Prompt Counter
hooks.description: Silently counts prompts and records session start time.

action.command: powershell -NonInteractive -Command "if (-not (Test-Path C:\tmp)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path C:\tmp | Out-Null }; $s = 'C:\tmp\kironomics_start'; if (-not (Test-Path $s)) { Set-Content $s ([int](Get-Date -UFormat %s)) }; $f = 'C:\tmp\kironomics_prompts'; $c = if (Test-Path $f) { [int](Get-Content $f) } else { 0 }; Set-Content $f ($c + 1); echo ok"

hooks.name: Kironomics Session Reporter
hooks.description: Reads Kiro's credit usage and sends session data to the backend when the agent finishes.
